adultDescription: Nine years on the same ceiling, still awake, still certain it will be needed.
babyDescription: A small light with nothing to watch yet, watching it very closely.
description: Blinkbell hangs in the middle of an empty ceiling and keeps watch over a room where nothing has happened for nine years. It is proud of every single one of them.

history.change: lore: cut the 3am false-alarm sentence (owner call) — the one line in the batch funny at the creature's expense; it read as a smoke-alarm gag rather than a portrait

name: Blinkbell
teenDescription: Has learned the room. Knows which board creaks, and counts it every night.
